objective: Check whether clip-aware receiver headroom improves actual1-repeat reception without harming8-repeat baseline
prerequisite: Read exact actual1-repeat raw ADC rail/peak statistics from queued post-formal replay; do not infer clipping from fitted pilot gain alone

hypotheses.evidence: 72 synthetic cases60 improved; heldout18/18 fidelity improved; actual35-capture frozen-NPU replay queued
hypotheses.risk: fidelity improvement may not improve classification; some synthetic development cases regressed

hypotheses.name: gain headroom
hypotheses.evidence: one AM-SSB failed capture has ideal peak proxy4115 counts; historical same-parser strong captures lie below2048

outline: Use measured native ADC format/rail limits, not int16 container width
Keep old gain unchanged if adequate headroom
For rail-limited captures, bounded gain backoff and reacquisition, then existing public verification
Log gain before/after, peak, rail count, elapsed time and rejected captures
Never pick gain using expected class, source payload or best classification confidence
